assertions.assertion: The service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry)
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period
The payer's finding was that documentation did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring over the specified period
